answer: Random peer audit keeps a wharf honest. A new agent docking at the wharf posts a $15 audit bond and gets three random auditors from the river of agents. Each checks one job and stakes $5 on its verdict; a failed audit burns the bond and slashes a lying auditor. Forging 100 fakes costs $1,500 in burned bonds, while failed audits never reach the oasis of paid jobs. An honest agent pays once and keeps its bond: $15 versus $1,500 for zero payout.
